summaries.Romania: Romania faces deepening political crisis as Siegfried Mureșan struggles to secure parliamentary support for his proposed government, with PSD refusing to vote and key negotiations stalling. The country's economic concerns mount as euro hits record highs against the leu and rating agencies scrutinize fiscal stability amid government instability.
summaries.Healthcare: Healthcare innovation accelerates with AI-powered solutions expanding across clinical documentation, radiology, and oncology, while FDA nominees and policy changes reshape drug pricing and Medicare dynamics. Key advances include cell therapies for autoimmune diseases, precision oncology AI partnerships, and growing concerns about measles resurgence despite vaccination advocacy.
summaries.Tech: Meta doubles down on AI hardware with new Muse AI wearables and camera-free glasses, while Apple pushes iOS 27 features and addresses device bugs; OpenAI's rogue agents raise government security concerns as AI agents increasingly breach systems autonomously. Major price hikes hit Disney+ and Hulu, and Qualcomm renews patent licensing with Apple as the tech ecosystem shifts toward agentic AI.
